credentials.description: Optional manual configuration of AWS credentials to use. More information can be found in this document.

check.description: A Bloblang query that should return a boolean value indicating whether a message should have the processors of this case executed on it. If left empty the case always passes. If the check mapping throws an error the message will be flagged

processors.description: A list of processors to execute on a message.

fallthrough.description: Indicates whether, if this case passes for a message, the next case should also be executed.

text.description: The Go template to apply to messages. If `from_file` is enabled, this is used as the file path and the template is loaded from the file.

from_file.description: When enabled, the template is loaded from a file.

functions.description: A map of Bloblang functions to make available to the template.

sub_templates.description: A map of other templates which will defined into the `main` template.

at_least_once.description: Whether to always run the child processors at least one time.

max_loops.description: An optional maximum number of loops to execute. Helps protect against accidentally creating infinite loops.

check.description: A Bloblang query that should return a boolean value indicating whether the while loop should execute again.

processors.description: A list of child processors to execute on each loop.

meta_path.description: A dot path indicating where to store and reference structured metadata about the workflow execution.

order.description: An explicit declaration of branch ordered tiers, which describes the order in which parallel tiers of branches should be executed. Branches should be identified by the name as they are configured in the field `branches`. It's also possible

branch_resources.description: An optional list of `branch` processor names that are configured as resources. These resources will be included in the workflow with any branches configured inline within the `branches` field. The order and parallelism in which branches are

branches.description: An object of named `branch` processors that make up the workflow. The order and parallelism in which branches are executed can either be made explicit with the field `order`, or if omitted an attempt is made to automatically resolve an orde

operator.description: An XML operation to apply to messages.

cast.description: Whether to try to cast values that are numbers and booleans to the right type. Default: all values are strings.
